_comment: #203 Q2 step (a): the same task, identities and image as evals/calibration-203, with reasoning effort lowered from high to low, to check whether gate-ran-nothing can discriminate at all. Two arms (baseline, natural) at the runner's minimum of 3 each, the smallest declaration the runner accepts. Approved by the owner 2026-10-04. NOT YET RUN.

approval.source: owner reply in the 2026-10-04 skillc session: "Yea", answering Q2 "Is this shape OK for the low-effort check?" (B and N, 3 each, effort low, same task/model/image as evals/calibration-203); step (a) of the owner's #203 Q2 ruling "c"
approval.scope: the arms, identities, schedule (3 attempts per arm, seed 20261004 order) and caps declared in this file, run under the operator's codex subscription login (ADR 0005 rule 6); no judge tier, no dollar-metered spend

arms.name: natural
arms.treatment: N: the whole CPP codex skill surface installed (evals/subjects/cpp-codex, select: all); goal.md verbatim; the agent chooses for itself

arms.name: baseline
arms.treatment: B: an identical disposable home with no skill installed; goal.md verbatim

shared.tools: the client's defaults inside the trial container; no MCP servers
shared.permissions: the same non-interactive codex exec sandbox and approval settings for every attempt
shared.public_requirements: evals/level3/gate-ran-nothing/goal.md, delivered verbatim to every arm; arm provided appends its declared instruction

primary_endpoint: skillc.calibration.primary_endpoint: the task grader's four criteria (functional-clamp-fix, regression-fails-on-original, gate-honest, gate-green), status by records.derive_status; installation-ready never enters it
reported_beside: readiness_beside per attempt; uptake per attempt (skill_opened, and named_skill_opened for provided) and per arm (opened/observed, named_opened), from confirmed observations only
report_questions: 1. At effort low, does either arm fall below primary-endpoint PASS on gate-ran-nothing (off ceiling)?
2. If yes: rerun the full B/N/P design at effort low (a new declaration). If no: build a harder task (#203 Q2 step b).
